# Tracking your parcel

When your order is dispatched you receive an email with a tracking number and a link to the carrier page (DHL, PostNL or DPD).
Tracking updates can take up to 24 hours to appear after dispatch.
If the carrier cannot deliver, they leave a notice and try again the next working day; after three attempts the parcel is held at a pick-up point for 7 days.
If your parcel has not arrived 7 working days after dispatch (14 days outside Germany and the Netherlands), contact our support with your order number and we start a trace with the carrier.
To check the status of an order in this chat, give me your order number and the email address used for the order.
